title: Teams
intro: The teams your organization compares flow metrics across. Everyone can see who is on a team; administrators manage teams and their members.

managerHint: The manager and administrators can edit the team's capacity

targets.title: Work-category targets
targets.heading: Work-category targets: {{name}}
targets.intro: The share of the team's effort each work category should take, in whole percent. The Costs report will compare the actual split against it in a later version. Everyone can see the targets; administrators edit them.
targets.readOnly: Only administrators can edit the targets.
targets.none: No targets are set for this team.
targets.rule: Whole numbers from 0 to 100. The total must be exactly 100 %; leave every field empty to set no targets.
targets.invalidTotal: The targets add up to {{total}} %, not 100 %. Make them add up to exactly 100 %, or leave every field empty for no targets.
targets.unmappedHint: A category marked "Not mapped any more" lost its place in the metrics configuration; its stored target is shown here but no report can use it.
targets.unmappedHintAdmin: A category marked "Not mapped any more" lost its place in the metrics configuration. It does not count towards the total, and saving drops its stored target.

error.forbidden: Only administrators can edit the targets
